subject: Whoa J&As — Oct 16: NIEHS blames DOGE executive order and staffing churn for missed epidemiology recompete
body:
## 1. NIEHS blames DOGE executive order and staffing churn for missed epidemiology recompete

**NATIONAL INSTITUTES OF HEALTH (HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES, DEPARTMENT OF) · Social & Scientific Systems Inc. · $20,000,000 (modification/increase) · 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1); RFO 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-15, award HHSN273201600003I, “Support Services for Epidemiology - NIEHS”*

NIEHS wants to extend the incumbent's epidemiology IDIQ two years and raise its ceiling. The document says Executive Order 14158 and staffing changes delayed the recompete.

> “Executive Order 14158 of January 20, 2025 Establishing and Implementing the President’s “Department of Government Efficiency” caused unforeseen circumstances beyond the control of the acquisition office”  
> — JA_SSS_HHSN273201600003I_PDF_Final 6.9.26.pdf, p. 1

> “The current recompetition has not yet begun and requires full two years”  
> — JA_SSS_HHSN273201600003I_PDF_Final 6.9.26.pdf, p. 2

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/ba03f3b292974c1d82e341f1c24484dd/view) · [JA_SSS_HHSN273201600003I_PDF_Final 6.9.26.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/ba03f3b292974c1d82e341f1c24484dd/9045b2b05d714c96b054ba0d36b72ec1_JA_SSS_HHSN273201600003I_PDF_Final_6.9.26.pdf)

## 2. Army sole-sources Vectrus to inventory combat-damaged CENTCOM equipment in Kuwait for Operation Epic Fury

**DEPT OF THE ARMY (DEPT OF DEFENSE) · Vectrus · value redacted · RFO 16.507-6(b)(1)**  
*Posted 2026-10-15, award W52P1J19D0045, “LOGCAP CES”*

The Army cites urgency to inventory and inspect equipment sets staged in Kuwait. It calls the action an emergency intervention in an active combat theater, and says the assets are un-inventoried and of unknown combat readiness.

> “This non-competitive action represents a highly critical, emergency intervention designed solely to recover operational control of combat-damaged strategic assets in an active combat theater.”  
> — A02 JEFO_CENTCOM Equipment Sets_Redacted.pdf, p. 4 (machine-transcribed page)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/be31499a00a346988debf5435b7503cf/view) · [A02 JEFO_CENTCOM Equipment Sets_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/be31499a00a346988debf5435b7503cf/345ed29af7d14b81b603c460083399bf_A02_JEFO_CENTCOM_Equipment_Sets_Redacted.pdf)

## 3. TSA bridge sole-source blamed on three FY2026 appropriations lapses and furloughs

**TRANSPORTATION SECURITY ADMINISTRATION (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · The Building People, LLC · $483,475 (total) · FAR 8.002**  
*Posted 2026-10-15, award 70T01026P7668N004, “Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services for the TSA Systems Integration Facility (TSIF) and Freedom Center”*

TSA says three lapses in appropriations and staff furloughs delayed the follow-on award for facility O&M, including the Freedom Center. It now needs a second bridge purchase order.

> “due to multiple lapses in appropriations during Fiscal Year 2026 (i.e., 10/1/2025–11/12/2025, 1/31/2026–2/3/2026, and 2/14/2026–4/30/2026)”  
> — SAP Commercial SAT to 9M Single Source Justification JAN 2026 OM Services Approved.pdf, p. 2

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/02ae837d64134e129529a568897316d0/view) · [SAP Commercial SAT to 9M Single Source Justification JAN 2026 OM Services Approved.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/02ae837d64134e129529a568897316d0/d12485de6bb3443d9d2ef468ce933728_SAP_Commercial_SAT_to_9M_Single_Source_Justification_JAN_2026_OM_Services_Approved.pdf)

## 4. DHS HSIN modernization extended after shutdowns and unreplicable 15-20-year-old SharePoint customizations

**OFFICE OF PROCUREMENT OPERATIONS (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · BridgePhase, LLC · value redacted · GSAR 538.7104-3(b)(ii); 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1)**  
*Posted 2026-10-15, award GS-35F-687GA, “HSIN Modernization”*

DHS proposes a 3-month extension for BridgePhase. It says shutdowns cut access to networks and personnel, and that the original developers of the legacy customizations are mostly unavailable.

> “Almost all of the resources that originally developed many of these customized features are no longer available, resulting in major hurdles in extracting requirements.”  
> — Sole Source Justification (HSIN Modernization_52.217-8)_Redacted.pdf, p. 2

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/7a97dbfdd83f440e993ee459c530402c/view) · [Sole Source Justification (HSIN Modernization_52.217-8)_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/7a97dbfdd83f440e993ee459c530402c/f2feeccd6b5e4d4b8eea53cfe3448249_Sole_Source_Justification_HSIN_Modernization_52.217-8__Redacted.pdf)

## 5. FLETC bridges roleplayers after GAO protest freezes its brand-new follow-on contract

**FEDERAL LAW ENFORCEMENT TRAINING CENTER (HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF) · Ops Tech Alliance · value redacted · 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1); RFO Subpart 6.103-1**  
*Posted 2026-10-15, award 70LGLY26CGLB00008, “Roleplayer Services”*

The follow-on contract was awarded September 10, 2026, and is under a GAO protest stay. FLETC wants a four-month sole-source bridge with the incumbent.

> “that follow on contract 70LGLY26CGLB00006 is currently under a statutory stay of performance due to a bid protest filed with the Government Accountability Office (GAO).”  
> — JA for RP Bridge redacted_Redacted.pdf, p. 2 (machine-transcribed page)

[SAM.gov notice](https://sam.gov/opp/236f4595c8ad45f5b2cadb0fa5c89373/view) · [JA for RP Bridge redacted_Redacted.pdf](https://huggingface.co/datasets/abigailhaddad/federal-ja-documents/resolve/e93882dcc18c1d76244974093b3696fd5e5e016e/files/236f4595c8ad45f5b2cadb0fa5c89373/3a40a0dd6cea4d38aef7b37691507d3f_JA_for_RP_Bridge_redacted_Redacted.pdf)
